title: UnSticking Leaves
description: Removes the stick drop from leaves blocks
body:
This pack changes the loot tables for various leaves blocks to remove the stick drop added in 1.14


Changes to the JSON formats that were made in 1.17 force the seperate versions for 1.14-1.16 and 1.17 forward.\
In addition to the 1.17► version, versions specifically for:\
1.17-1.19\
1.20.0-1.20.4\
1.20.5-1.20.6\
&\
1.21►
are included.


Note: Version 1a replaces version 1 having a pack.png that indicates the intended game versions. (Version 1 has been removed.)
